No one works harder to expose corruption in Congress and bring taxpayers real transparency.

We introduced a resolution to expose Congress's sexual harassment and misconduct records, every single one. The names, the cases, the details they've been burying behind closed doors for years.

Both parties teamed up to kill it. Protecting themselves. Protecting their friends.

We didn't stop there. We moved to subpoena the sexual harassment slush fund records, the ones showing exactly how much of your

Grooming children is not something to celebrate.

Not now, not ever. Protect our kids.

From day one, we have been the biggest champion for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein. We were one of only four Republicans to force the release of the Epstein files. 

We will always stand for justice for those who have been silenced and ignored. They deserve the truth. They deserve accountability.

This isn't political for us, it's personal. Our moral compass will never allow us to look the other way.

Hold the Line.

JUST IN: We're introducing a constitutional amendment tomorrow to slam shut one of the biggest loopholes in American immigration law: automatic citizenship for children born on U.S. soil to parents who are here illegally.

The joint resolution would clarify, under the 14th Amendment, a person born in the United States is only "subject to the jurisdiction" of the United States, and eligible for citizenship, if at least one parent is a U.S. citizen, a U.S. national, or a lawful permanent resident.

When Moncks Corner needed help making its streets safer, we delivered. 

We helped the town secure a $1.2 MILLION federal grant to advance a key infrastructure project designed to improve pedestrian safety, connectivity and access throughout Moncks Corner.

It does not matter who you are or where you come from. If you cannot do the job, you should not have the job.

DEI has no place in the military, the FBI, the Secret Service, law enforcement, or fire departments. Putting DEI over merit will cost people their lives.

Video

Our Skills-Based Federal Contracting Act PASSED the House in February.

The federal government has been requiring college degrees for contractor jobs where a degree has nothing to do with the work. Hardworking Americans with real skills have been locked out. Not because they are unqualified. Because they did not spend four years in a classroom.

Our bill stops federal agencies from slapping unnecessary degree requirements on contractor positions without written justification.

Taxpayers deserve

I was born and raised in South Carolina. I grew up in Goose Creek, a small town rooted in hard work, faith, and love for our country. This is not just where I am from. It is part of who I am. 

Growing up in the Lowcountry has shaped everything I do. The values I learned growing up here are the same values I carry with me every single day in Congress. 

South Carolina gave me my voice. And it gave me a purpose. The people of this state deserve a representative who goes to Washington and actually

Today marks the start of the 2026 hurricane season here in South Carolina.

Now through November 30th, it is important to stay prepared and stay informed. We want to ensure our communities stay safe and are ready for whatever this season may bring.

South Carolina STRONG.

The government should not be making it harder to buy your first home.

We introduced the First-Time Homebuyer Savings Act of 2026 to give first-time buyers in South Carolina and across the country a real chance. This bill establishes tax-advantaged savings accounts where eligible individuals can contribute up to $10,000 annually in pre-tax funds, grow their money tax-free, and withdraw it tax-free for qualified homebuying expenses.

This relief is targeted toward working Americans. Individuals m

Making America Great Again should be the agenda of every single member of our government.

Putting America first is not controversial. It is our job. It is the standard.

Thank you, President Trump, for leading our country.

Before Congress, there was The Citadel.

I was the first woman to graduate from the Corps of Cadets.

Nothing was handed to me there. In fact, I didn't even tell my father I had applied and was accepted until after the fact. 

This is the place where we salute the American flag, not burn it to the ground. This is where you go to learn grit, discipline, and to be strong.

This is where I learned what I was made of. And those lessons have never left me.

The Citadel prepared me for a lifetime of s

MACE WIN: We helped secure the largest infrastructure grant in South Carolina state history. $195 million to improve Long Point Road for the Port.

The Port of Charleston is one of the largest job creators in our state and generates a staggering $87 billion in annual statewide economic impact.

This critical investment will strengthen the port, reduce congestion, and keep freight and families moving while supporting jobs and economic growth across the Lowcountry.

South Carolina STRONG.

Clean food. Clean water. Honest science. It’s time to put the health of the American people ahead of corporate profits and hold government agencies accountable to the people they serve.

We fully stand with President Trump and the MAHA initiative because South Carolina families deserve transparency, accountability, and real answers. Our children deserve a healthier future than what Washington has allowed for far too long.

Make America Healthy Again.

Waffle House is where I got my start at 17 years old.

I have never forgotten where I came from or what a hard day’s work feels like. I have never forgotten what it means to stretch a dollar as far as it can possibly go. 

Every decision I make is made with this in mind. The ones pulling double shifts. The ones building something from nothing because no one handed them anything. The hardworking people of South Carolina.

South Carolina raised me right. And I am going to keep working like it.

America's military is the strongest, most lethal fighting force in the world. DEI policies threaten exactly this. 

Every dollar spent on these initiatives is a dollar taken away from readiness, lethality, and the warfighters who earn it. 

We thank Secretary Hegseth for restoring merit and standards back to our military where they belong.

Video

Our military families sacrifice everything for this country. The very least we can do is make sure their kids are getting an education, not a political agenda.

We introduced the No Woke Indoctrination of Military Kids Act because no child in a school overseen by the Department of War should be pressured into adopting an ideology instead of learning how to read, write, and think for themselves.

This bill bans Critical Race Theory and DEI programs from every Department of War school in the count
